blocks.en: The Arzela-Ascoli theorem states that sequences of functions on a compact set which satisfy certain conditions have uniformly convergent subsequences. Results of this nature are often useful in existence proofs; the thing which must be proved to exist is the limit of the convergent subsequence. To state the theorem, we need the following definition.
blocks.zh: Arzela-Ascoli 定理指出, 紧集上满足某些条件的函数序列具有一致收敛子列. 这类结果在存在性证明中常常有用; 需要证明存在的对象就是收敛子列的极限. 为陈述该定理, 需要以下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $f_m$ be a sequence of real-valued functions defined in a subset $D$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Let $\bm{x}\in D$. The sequence is called \textbf{equicontinuous} at $\bm{x}$ if, for every $\epsilon>0$, there is a $\delta>0$, independent of $m$, such that $|f_m(\bm{y})-f_m(\bm{x})|<\epsilon$ for $\bm{y}\in D$ with $|\bm{y}-\bm{x}|<\delta$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f_m$ 为定义在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的子集 $D$ 上的实值函数序列. 设 $\bm{x}\in D$. 若对每个 $\epsilon>0$, 都存在不依赖于 $m$ 的 $\delta>0$, 使对满足 $|\bm{y}-\bm{x}|<\delta$ 的 $\bm{y}\in D$ 都有 $|f_m(\bm{y})-f_m(\bm{x})|<\epsilon$, 则称该序列在 $\bm{x}$ 处\textbf{等度连续}.
blocks.label: def:equicontinuity

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: If the sequence $f_m$ is equicontinuous at each point of a compact set $S$, it is uniformly equicontinuous, i.e., $\delta$ in the definition above can be chosen independently of $\bm{x}\in S$ (cf. Problem~\ref{ex:compact-equicontinuity-uniform}; it is not necessary that $D=S$). We note that a sequence of functions is equicontinuous at $\bm{x}$ if there exists a bound (independent of $m$) for the derivatives in some neighborhood of $\bm{x}$.
blocks.zh: 若序列 $f_m$ 在紧集 $S$ 的每一点处都等度连续, 则它一致等度连续, 即上述定义中的 $\delta$ 可以不依赖于 $\bm{x}\in S$ 来选取 (参见 Problem~\ref{ex:compact-equicontinuity-uniform}; 不要求 $D=S$). 注意, 若在 $\bm{x}$ 的某个邻域内导数具有不依赖于 $m$ 的界, 则函数序列在 $\bm{x}$ 处等度连续.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $f_m$ be a sequence of real-valued functions defined on a compact subset $S$ of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Assume that there is a constant $M$ such that $|f_m(\bm{x})|\leq M$ for every $m\in\mathbb{N}$ and every $\bm{x}\in S$. Moreover, assume that the sequence $f_m$ is equicontinuous at every point of $S$. Then there exists a subsequence which converges uniformly on $S$.
blocks.zh: 设 $f_m$ 为定义在 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 的紧子集 $S$ 上的实值函数序列. 假设存在常数 $M$, 使对每个 $m\in\mathbb{N}$ 和每个 $\bm{x}\in S$ 都有 $|f_m(\bm{x})|\leq M$. 再假设序列 $f_m$ 在 $S$ 的每一点处等度连续. 那么存在一个在 $S$ 上一致收敛的子列.
blocks.label: thm:arzela-ascoli

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: We remark that (with rather obvious modifications) the theorem and proof can be extended to the case where $S$ is a compact set in an abstract topological space and the values of $f_m$ are in a complete metric space.
blocks.zh: 指出, 经过相当明显的修改, 定理和证明可以推广到 $S$ 为抽象拓扑空间中的紧集, 且 $f_m$ 的值位于完备度量空间中的情形.

blocks.en: Below, we shall have to apply the Arzela-Ascoli theorem to sequences of harmonic functions. In this particular case, we have the following result.
blocks.zh: 下文需要对调和函数序列应用 Arzela-Ascoli 定理. 对这一特殊情形, 有以下结果.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Let $f_m$ be a sequence of harmonic functions on $\Omega$ which is uniformly bounded, i.e., $|f_m(\bm{x})|\leq M$ for every $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ and $m\in\mathbb{N}$. Then $f_m$ has a subsequence which converges to a harmonic function on $\Omega$, uniformly on compact subsets of $\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中的区域. 设 $f_m$ 为 $\Omega$ 上一致有界的调和函数序列, 即对每个 $\bm{x}\in\Omega$ 和 $m\in\mathbb{N}$ 都有 $|f_m(\bm{x})|\leq M$. 那么 $f_m$ 有一个子列, 收敛到 $\Omega$ 上的调和函数, 并在 $\Omega$ 的紧子集上一致收敛.
blocks.label: thm:harmonic-sequence-compactness

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
Let $\Omega_k=\{\bm{x}\in\Omega\mid|\bm{x}|\leq k,\ \operatorname{dist}(\bm{x},\partial\Omega)\geq1/k\}$. Then $\Omega_k$ is compact and $\Omega=\bigcup_{k=1}^\infty\Omega_k$. If $\bm{x}$ is in $\Omega_k$, then, in a neighborhood of $\bm{x}$, we can represent $f_m$ by Poisson\textquotesingle s formula, using a ball centered at $\bm{x}$ with radius $1/2k$. This yields uniform estimates for the derivatives of $f_m$ on $\Omega_k$. In particular, the $f_m$ are equicontinuous on $\Omega_k$. By the Arzela-Ascoli theorem, we can extract a uniformly convergent subsequence on each $\Omega_k$, and using a diagonal argument similar to that used in the proof above, we obtain a subsequence converging on all of $\Omega$, uniformly on each $\Omega_k$.

It remains to show that the limit of this subsequence is harmonic. To see this, we simply note that harmonic functions are characterized by the property that they obey Poisson\textquotesingle s formula on every ball. If Poisson\textquotesingle s formula is obeyed by all functions in a uniformly convergent sequence, it also holds for the limit.
blocks.zh:
令 $\Omega_k=\{\bm{x}\in\Omega\mid|\bm{x}|\leq k,\ \operatorname{dist}(\bm{x},\partial\Omega)\geq1/k\}$. 那么 $\Omega_k$ 是紧的, 且 $\Omega=\bigcup_{k=1}^\infty\Omega_k$. 若 $\bm{x}$ 位于 $\Omega_k$ 中, 则在 $\bm{x}$ 的一个邻域内, 可用以 $\bm{x}$ 为球心, 半径为 $1/2k$ 的球, 通过 Poisson 公式表示 $f_m$. 这给出 $f_m$ 在 $\Omega_k$ 上的导数的一致估计. 特别地, $f_m$ 在 $\Omega_k$ 上等度连续. 由 Arzela-Ascoli 定理, 可在每个 $\Omega_k$ 上提取一致收敛子列, 再使用与上述证明类似的对角论证, 得到在整个 $\Omega$ 上收敛, 且在每个 $\Omega_k$ 上一致收敛的子列.

剩下只需证明这一子列的极限调和. 为此, 只需注意, 调和函数的特征性质是在每个球上都满足 Poisson 公式. 若一致收敛序列中的所有函数都满足 Poisson 公式, 则极限也满足该公式.
